comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper stop; this record clamps wood in a screw vise and saws a 150 mm piece.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs fine coupled screw/nut countertorque; the record tightens a vise and maintains an unguided saw cut through material.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained angular function; the record checks prior clamping, physical separation, a 150±1 mm retained length, intact positioning, and saw clearance.
comparison.reason: Workholding and material removal to length test forceful cutting accuracy, not an adjustable mechanism's lock retention.
